questions_and_acceptance.a_optima_real: Re-run BOTH claimed optima from scratch plus >=1 L-neighbour each side and >=1 W-neighbour each side. ACCEPT the minimum as REAL iff (i) every re-run reproduces the committed row to rel<1e-4 on t_hop/VBEND/VA_open, (ii) the objective value at the optimum is strictly below both immediate functional neighbours, and (iii) the margin to the best neighbour EXCEEDS the cross-harness resolution spread from GC. If the margin is inside the spread, the optimum is a GRID/RESOLUTION ARTEFACT and I will say so.
questions_and_acceptance.b_percell: Police all 8 cells INDIVIDUALLY from the raw .prn (not from a 2-cell representative). The lsw deck prints only V(o0),V(o1); the sk deck prints V(o0)..V(o7). Accept iff every one of the 8 is >=90% settled at t_open+495ps AND the per-cell 90% times spread <2% within each group. ALSO check the rail actually drains: compare the DERIVED VA_open = dV - Q_L/CA against the DIRECTLY PRINTED V(bka) at t_open; accept iff they agree to <=1 mV.
questions_and_acceptance.c_tsettle: Determine by reading the code path and re-deriving from the waveform whether t_settle is (i) a genuine measured interval to 90% of the DELIVERED rail, (ii) a measurement in a DIFFERENT circuit, or (iii) inferred by subtracting t_hop from a total. Then measure, on the SAME deck, the genuine post-rail settle interval t_out90 - t_rail90 and compare it to the floor value used in the surfaces. If the two terms of SUM overlap in the measured timeline, SUM is not a decomposition and I will report by how much.
questions_and_acceptance.d_minW: The pre-registered width ladder is {15,30,60,120,240} um = 2x steps. Test INTERMEDIATE widths at both optima (L=10: W=24; L=6: W=80, W=90). If an intermediate width is FUNCTIONAL, the claimed optimum used a switch wider than necessary, t_hop is pessimistic and the objective value improves -> the reported optimum is a WIDTH-LADDER ARTEFACT.
questions_and_acceptance.e_twohigh: Independently re-measure the 2-high pMOS stack at the highest characterised swing: (1) my own ideal-supply deck (no bank) at 1.65/1.50/1.20/0.80 V, (2) the o21ai BANK at dV=1.65, L=10 and L=15, W=30, tail 2000 ps. CONFIRM iff t_valid90 exists inside a 500 ps window at dV=1.65 and the stack reaches >=99% on an ideal supply at every characterised swing. REFUTE if the bank number depends on the tail length or if 'settling' is the rail falling onto the output rather than the output rising.
questions_and_acceptance.f_verdict: defensible optimum per objective + confidence + whether the two objectives really select different points.
